action.instructions:
Win this run.
Collect ALL free gold and relics. If potion space is free, TAKE the offered combat potion before Proceed; saving it costs nothing. Inspect every uninspected CardReward for free, then choose a card or Skip. Do not reopen already declined offers. Discard only to replace a held potion with a better offered one when the belt is full; disposal grants no effect.
Take free potions into empty slots. Use lasting buffs BEFORE affected cards in hard fights. Spend potions to prevent ~10+ HP loss or secure kills; if safe, reserve a useful boss answer. Never hoard through death or a full-belt replacement.
Choose one offered action using the current state.
